entries.name: human-female
required_variants: neutral base and separate Qud tint/detail

Shared-human-base consistency must be reviewed across named human variants; independent turnarounds allowed unsupported proportion drift. The standard human shown in the gallery has tapered leg stubs without recognizable feet; construct and review feet and contact in every orientation.

process_log.phase: Original shapes and captured female human anatomy
process_log.action: Resolved female humans from the captured JoppaFarmerConvert and watervine farmer instances, retaining source descriptions, ancestry, body trees and actual equipment.
process_log.review: Inspected the packet and reference plate. The body plan is Humanoid with paired feet, two hands and one head; no race-wide nude description exists. Captured gender does not establish mandatory morphology or a life stage.

process_log.phase: Female donor convention and shared human reference
process_log.action: Selected exact installed Core Naked_Female_south and Female_Average_Normal_south, retaining the completed male base as the common design family.
process_log.review: Viewed the actual donor torso and head. Their role is body-type presentation and clean game shading; Qud identity and separate gear remain authoritative.

process_log.phase: Manual front derived from the shared human geometry
process_log.action: Retained shared human head, arms, hands and explicit bare feet, with a modest authored torso/hip variation based on the donor convention.
process_log.review: Viewed rendered front: one head, two arms/hands, two legs and two feet; relaxed neutral mannequin. The body variation is an authoring convention, not claimed as native anatomical fact.

process_log.phase: Refined front proposal and foot correction identified
process_log.action: Refined the manually constructed shared-family female front. Retained the returned image as an intermediate proposal; its false ankle-cuff lines need correction.
process_log.review: One head/two arms/hands/two legs and feet retained. Front body belongs to the shared human family. Ankle seams resemble shoe cuffs; request removal with the selected male bare feet as reference in the next proposal.

process_log.phase: Secondary views with the shared male family reference
process_log.action: Generated female front/side/back from its refined front and the selected male turnaround; explicitly corrected the ankle cuffs and retained modest ordinary contour differences.
process_log.review: Viewed all three: feet now read as bare feet, side torso/limbs turn together, rear view has heels. No new appendages or cosmetics. Subtle torso/hip curves remain within the shared human design.

process_log.phase: Patched view registration and neutral source
process_log.action: Removed generated labels, cleared invisible background RGB/low-alpha fringe, converted to equal-channel grayscale and translated feet onto one baseline.
process_log.review: Viewed the patched sheet. Side foot/arm overlap is coherent; head and body turn, and no ankle cuff remains. No anatomical-count correction needed. Next is the required composed refinement.

process_log.action: Refined the composed patched sheet once, retaining the same human family and modest curves.
process_log.review: Viewed output: coherent front/side/back, no cuff seams, extra appendages, clothes or cosmetics. Side limb occlusion and foot direction are retained; rear view uses heels.

process_log.phase: Separate female body/head layers and masks
process_log.action: Registered the selected views, cleared invisible RGB, neutralized source shading and split body/head using explicit neck masks with two-pixel body underlap.
process_log.review: Inspected the recomposed registered image: no neck gaps or cropped hands/feet. Body contains painted limbs; head is separate. No garment or foreign hand outline is baked into an equipment layer. Native use waits for the complete generated set.

process_log.action: Reviewed the registered assembly and intended-size authoring previews. Finished this entry's generation work without native testing.
process_log.review: Same family as the male human, with modest contour variation. Blank head, two arms/hands, two legs and distinct bare feet. Side turns coherently; rear feet are heels; west mirrors east. Clothing remains separate and its fitting entries are pending.

process_log.action: Translated all body/head/mask layers together to contact (256, 950), preserving v1, dimensions and exact visible source pixels. Replaced facing-dependent horizontal offsets with the shared canvas pivot.
process_log.review: Viewed all four facings with center/ground guides. Front/back align on the canvas center; side and mirrored side keep the same contact while retaining profile asymmetry. No cut limbs or displaced neck joins. Native movement acceptance remains pending.

process_log.action: Resolved Argyve, Mehmet and captured male watervine farmers to reusable human anatomy. Preserved individual descriptions, attached native body trees, actual gear, source hashes and uncertainty.

outputs.role: Exact source packet and authored anatomy contract
Annotated Qud original shapes alongside donor conventions

process_log.review: Inspected the exact metadata and contextual source plate. Two arms, two hands and paired feet; no native race-wide appearance prose. The original clothed sprite is not a nude anatomy diagram.

process_log.action: Selected installed Core Naked_Male_south and Male_Average_Normal_south for presentation only. Verified the extracted PNG hashes against the recorded catalogue; DLC/mod references remain eligible for subjects that need them.
process_log.review: Viewed donor torso/head reference. Ordinary donor humanlike body has no independent rendered arms/legs; this Qud body keeps them painted into the body graphic. No donor race substitution.

process_log.action: Constructed original editable adult front with two visible arms/hands, paired legs and explicit rounded bare feet. Preserved the non-detailed neutral mannequin convention; personal cosmetics and occupation gear remain separate.

inputs.role: Exact geometry and plate construction method

process_log.review: Viewed the rendered PNG: one head, two arms/hands, two legs and two distinct feet. Foot overlap/ankle contours still require the refinement review. This passes construction only, not final body or native acceptance.
process_log.settings: 512x1024 transparent SVG render; deterministic authored geometry

process_log.action: Refined only the constructed front with built-in ImageGen, using the manual front and the inspected source/reference plate.
process_log.review: Viewed full output: one blank head, two arms/hands, two legs and distinct short bare feet with toes. Foot stubs corrected. Neutral low-chroma gray; exact alpha inspected. No clothes or personal cosmetics. Front selected as the next view-generation anchor, not final native art.

process_log.phase: Secondary views proposed from the front
process_log.action: Generated the same adult body in front, right-facing side and back using only the reviewed refined front plus explicit anatomy facts.

outputs.role: Raw proposed turnaround, including generated labels

process_log.review: Viewed the raw sheet. Side body/legs/foot rotate coherently and far limbs are occluded. Back has no face features or front toes. Proposal changes the front slightly and low-chroma fill/alpha still require controlled cleanup.

process_log.action: Restored selected front, cleared labels, normalized neutral grayscale and alpha, and aligned foot contact. No anatomy-count patch was necessary; the side silhouette supports occluded far limbs.

outputs.role: Exact patch regions and registration decisions

process_log.review: Inspected patched sheet: feet visible in every applicable direction, genuine side profile, no background or labels in sprite panels. Back head/torso breadth consistency is explicitly requested in the composed refinement.

process_log.action: Refined the composed patched sheet once, preserving count, directions and bare feet; selected its coherent three-view result.
process_log.review: Viewed the complete returned sheet: one head/two arms/hands/two legs/feet; side is a full-body profile and back shows heels rather than front toes. Front/back head and torso remain the same body family. Raw transparent pixels carry irrelevant background RGB; registration explicitly clears it.

process_log.phase: Registered body, head and explicit masks
process_log.action: Registered selected views to physical contact, converted source to true grayscale, split body/head with explicit masks and a two-pixel body underlap. Prepared an isolated native contract.

outputs.role: Exact layer registration and palette contract

process_log.review: Viewed registered assembly and normal-size authoring sheet. Recomposition preserves the body and neck; no separate limb nodes added. Source pixels have equal RGB channels, with body/head under native foreground tint. Historical clothing remains unaccepted and is not regenerated by this body entry.

process_log.action: Reviewed the same registered model at 48x96 and 2x nearest display; native captures are still pending.
process_log.review: Feet remain visible and side foot points right. No shoulder/neck holes or extra hands. The entry remains IN PROGRESS until the real native body evidence and current bindings are reviewed.

process_log.action: Ran isolated hidden native Qud with the registered human body. Four-facing captures rendered, but the existing diagnostic rejected a completed hurt reaction for missing its narrow midpoint window; save/load was not reached.
process_log.review: Failure inspected. Actual hurt start/end exist; no claim of a passing batch or save/load. Diagnostic is corrected without changing animation timing, then a new isolated run will verify completion.

process_log.action: User requires generation of all pending textures, objects and creatures before native validation. The already-running second probe exited; no new probe will be started. Reverted the diagnostic code change and retained the existing generated artwork.
process_log.review: No validation acceptance or completion credit assigned. Resume generation and its visual corrections. Native checks remain pending until the all-conversions gate.

process_log.phase: Authoring complete: shared human male base
process_log.action: Concluded visual authoring review of the registered neutral model, including explicit feet and whole-body side orientation. Native acceptance is intentionally pending until all conversions are generated.
process_log.review: Body/head layers recompose without a neck gap. Two arms/hands and paired feet are retained; east is a genuine profile, north has rear heels, west uses the documented east mirror. Equal RGB channels preserve neutral source tint. Clothing fitting belongs to the separate fitting entries.

process_log.action: Translated body, head and segmentation masks together to contact (256, 950) on unchanged 512 x 1024 canvases. Preserved v1 and replaced compensating horizontal render offsets with a common canvas pivot. No resizing or native testing.
process_log.review: Viewed front, side, back and mirrored west with guides: shared horizontal center and ground contact, complete hands/feet and unchanged head/body joins. Exact source pixels inside art bounds survive translation; full-canvas mask padding clips only outside visible art. Side profile retains natural asymmetry.

entries.name: human male older template
known_issues: User-requested age variant of the selected shared human family. No native life-stage selector established; do not change NPC demographics.

process_log.action: Recorded the requested older human variant, original Qud age reference, actual adult donor references, and the source hierarchy.
process_log.review: Inspected the plate and packet. Irudad supplies explicit old-face/hunched-back prose, but extra arms/tail are individual mutations, not generic aging. No distinct aged donor torso or native age selector is established; age variation is authored.

process_log.action: Adjusted the shared human editable torso to softened shoulders and midsection, retaining head, limbs, bare feet and presentation.
process_log.review: Viewed the manually constructed front. Same human family and anatomy; no clothes, personal hair/eyes, mutation appendages or profession pose. This is an age-related authoring suggestion, not a new native demographic.

process_log.phase: Rejected older front: athletic shading replaced age cues
process_log.action: Generated a first refined older front from the construction and shared male reference. Rejected it because the returned shoulder/pectoral shading reads more athletic and did not establish the intended age variation.
process_log.review: Anatomy/feet were retained, but the age brief was missed. Do not select this as an older human. Make one focused correction to the shoulder/torso planes and age-specific head/neck planes while preserving the family.

process_log.action: Applied one focused correction to the rejected athletic proposal, keeping the manually constructed human family and adding restrained age-related neck/cheek planes and a softer torso.
process_log.review: Viewed output: softer sloped shoulders, relaxed abdomen and subtle neck/cheek creases. One blank head, two arms/hands and two bare feet remain; no hair, eyes, clothing or mutation appendages. Selected as the older front anchor.

process_log.action: Generated secondary views from the corrected older front and explicit shared-family/age anatomy.
process_log.review: Viewed three directions: the side has restrained rounded upper back and forward head, with whole-body rotation and occluded far limbs. Rear head and heels read as back view. No mutation appendages or clothing.

process_log.action: Cleaned generated labels/alpha, restored neutral source and aligned contacts before composed refinement.
process_log.review: Contact/neutrality patches only; no count or attachment error required rebuilding. Preserve the age cues during the composed refinement.

process_log.phase: Corrected unequal view boundaries before refinement
process_log.action: Caught that the proposal did not use equal columns: the front right hand crossed x512, and the back left hand began before x1024. Preserved v1 and replaced its segmentation with inspected full-figure regions.
process_log.review: Viewed the corrected composed sheet: each panel now owns its complete figure, including both front/back hands. Scale unchanged; baseline aligned. V1 is retained as rejected segmentation evidence and must not be registered.

process_log.action: Refined the correctly separated v2 composed sheet, keeping the unmutated human family, mild older stance and complete hands/feet.
process_log.review: Viewed all directions. Retains relaxed torso, older neck/knee planes, slight forward head and rounded upper back in side view. Same one head/two arms/hands/two legs/feet; no added mutations, clothing or personal cosmetics.

process_log.phase: Registered older body/head and explicit masks
process_log.action: Registered the selected complete-figure views at the shared physical human height, with grayscale source, separate head/neck masks and two-pixel body underlap.
process_log.review: Viewed the recomposition: no missing hands/feet or neck gaps. Intrinsic age planes remain in the body/head art. No mutation appendages are baked into this reusable race variant.

process_log.action: Reviewed the registered views and intended-size authoring preview, including complete hands after correcting the unequal-column proposal.
process_log.review: Front/back feet and hands remain visible; side is a whole-body profile with occluded far limbs. Grayscale source supports Qud foreground tint and separate clothing colors. Generation-ready only; native acceptance remains pending.

process_log.action: Recorded this as an authored older-human variant without assigning a numerical age or changing villagers. It may supply Irudad's unmutated baseline later; his mutation metadata stays separate.
process_log.review: No native age selector is assumed. Mutation appendages and actual equipped items remain separate from the reusable older human base.

process_log.action: Translated body/head/masks together to contact (256, 950), keeping the original size, age shape and head/body segmentation. Preserved the previous registration and its evidence.
process_log.review: Viewed front, east, back and mirrored west with center/ground guides: identical anchor, no clipping, complete hands/feet and unchanged neck join. Side lean remains part of the authored older shape. Exact source pixels preserved. No native tests run.

validation_gate: Native/formal integration validation only after every pending conversion is generation-ready; visual correction remains generation work.
baseline_policy: Reusable unmutated race body first. Derive ordinary age/sex variants; separate clothing and mutation framework. Intrinsic species anatomy stays in the race base.
